about: Lambton Shores is a municipality on Lake Huron in Lambton County, Ontario, linking Grand Bend, Forest, Thedford, and Arkona—not a single city. Beaches, dune parks, and rural inland villages share a long shoreline corridor between Sarnia and Goderich country. About 12,000 people live in Lambton Shores.
